title: The Role of Quantization in Loss Spikes
abstract: arXiv:2610.38277v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Loss spikes in language model pretraining can waste substantial compute and derail otherwise healthy training runs. A primary driver of these instabilities is the growth and divergence of output logits in the final language modeling (LM) head. In this work, we study a particularly costly form of this instability associated with output logit growth: delayed, terminal divergences that emerge only after prolonged training, which we call time-bomb spikes. We find that these instabilities are preceded by rapidly growing quantization error in the LM head, which eventually culminates in a loss spike. Crucially, reducing numerical precision accelerates time-bomb spikes, while increasing precision improves stability. We then propose a simple yet effective mitigation that replaces AdamW on the LM head with SGD with momentum, suppressing logit growth and improving stability over long training horizons. translated_title: 量化在损失尖峰中的作用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.38277v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：语言模型预训练中的损失尖峰会浪费大量计算资源，并使原本健康的训练过程脱轨。这些不稳定性的一个主要驱动因素是最终语言建模（LM）头中输出逻辑值的增长和发散。在这项工作中，我们研究了与输出逻辑值增长相关的一种代价尤为高昂的不稳定性形式：延迟的、仅在长时间训练后才出现的终端发散，我们将其称为“定时炸弹尖峰”。我们发现，这些不稳定性出现之前，语言模型头中的量化误差会快速增长，最终导致损失尖峰。至关重要的是，降低数值精度会加速定时炸弹尖峰的出现，而提高精度则能改善稳定性。随后，我们提出了一种简单而有效的缓解方法：用带动量的SGD替换语言模型头上的AdamW，从而抑制逻辑值增长，并在长时间训练范围内提高稳定性。最后，我们发现现有的缓解技术……
tldr: 该论文揭示了语言模型头中量化误差的快速增长是导致延迟性“定时炸弹”损失尖峰的根本原因，并提出用带动量的SGD替换LM头上的AdamW来抑制逻辑值增长、提升长程训练稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies rapidly growing quantization error in the LM head as the root cause of delayed "time-bomb" loss spikes, and proposes replacing AdamW with momentum SGD on the LM head to suppress logit growth and improve long-horizon training stability.
